name: Usha Martin Ltd.
about: Usha Martin Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel wires, strands, wire ropes, wire drawing and allied machine, cord, and related accessories in India and internationally. The company offers wire ropes, including crane, mining, elevator, oil and offshore, fishing, general engineering, aerial transportation, structural, and forestry ropes, as well as conveyor cords. It also provides spring, welding, fencing, ACSR, needle, mesh, fishhook, CHQ, spoke, and brush wires; LRPC strands comprising compacted, indented, un-bonded polymer coated, and bonded polymer LRPC strands; and wire drawing, tabular stranding, planetary stranding, bunching, and wire treatment machines. In addition, the company offers pre-tensioning, and post-tensioning solutions; prestressing solutions; and optical fiber, aerial cables, micro ducts, hybrid category, FTTH/drop, aerial copper, duct

reasons: Price implies ~22% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~10% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
